Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 8
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly “normalized” the unanimously cited death year from 323 BCE to 322 BCE by misapplying astronomical year numbering and civil-year conventions. Astronomical year -322 corresponds to 323 BCE, not 322 BCE, and all cited reputable sources (Britannica, History.com, World History Encyclopedia) state 323 BCE.
